summary.intent: Adopt a local review loop: run the Codex CLI review on two open PRs (#634/#242 and #638/#246) against main, fix everything it raises in one batch, run the gate, and re-run Codex until clean before pushing to the paid PR reviewer.
summary.outcome: Ran Codex on both PRs, fixed its findings (nothing-to-release diagnostics on #242; CR line endings, serialize-before-confirm, symlink-loop precheck, NO_COLOR pty tests on #246), added tests that pass, and launched the full gate plus fuzz-check. The second Codex pass and the push had not yet happened.

repo: Each PR is developed in its own worktree (e.g. .claude/worktrees/wp-onboarding-friction-fix) with a full gate that must pass before pushing.
Changes touching callisto-model also require running fuzz-check.
ReleaseNothingReport JSON output now carries a `diagnostics` array that is omitted when empty; the nothing-to-release e2e test and spec REL-CMD-05 were updated accordingly.
Pty-based interactive tests must ignore an inherited NO_COLOR setting or they behave differently across environments.
Init flow should skip the workflow question only when a workflow file actually exists; a symlink loop should still be offered and fail before anything is written.

code.finding: Nothing-to-release e2e test was updated to expect the pending hint in the diagnostics array.
Add flow now treats a lone CR as a line end and serializes the changeset before the 'Write this changeset?' confirmation so unwritable changesets are refused early.
Precheck now only treats an existing workflow as skip-worthy; symlink-loop cases fail in the precheck rather than being skipped.

workflow: Run the same reviewer locally (codex review --base main) before pushing so the paid PR reviewer only sees already-cleared code.
Batch all review findings per PR into one fix pass, then gate, then re-review until a pass is empty.
Codex review will not accept a custom prompt together with --base; use the default review prompt.
Run independent Codex reviews as parallel background jobs and read their output files on completion.

friction: Codex rejected a custom prompt combined with --base, forcing a switch to the default review.
The script edit via shell was blocked because the directory is write-protected for shell commands, so two runs used the stale command before the script was rewritten with the Write tool.
Initial Codex runs on both PRs were wasted using the old script.
open_items: Second Codex pass on both PRs must come back clean before pushing.
Gate and fuzz-check results from the last run were read but not reported in the transcript, so their outcome needs confirmation.
Pre-existing open findings on #246 (one medium, two lows) and #242 (one low) were to be folded into the batches; their resolution is unconfirmed.
